channel.title: Navan Badminton Club
channel.description: Welcome to Navan Badminton Club located at Claremont Stadium in Navan, Co. Meath, Ireland. Club nights every Monday and Wednesday during the season which runs from September to April. Club caters for Adults and Juveniles of all standards from beginner to advanced.

item.title: Monday Club Night at Claremont Stadium ☕
item.description: Monday Club Night at Claremont Stadium featuring Grade 4 Mixed: Navan 'B' vs Mullingar 'A', plus juvenile sessions and extra courts for members from 8:30pm.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Incredible Weekend at the Leinster CAC Graded Individuals!
item.description: Our players showcased exceptional talent and sportsmanship at the Leinster CAC Graded Individuals, bringing home several accolades. A massive shoutout to Miriam Keogan for her dual victories!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)
